note: A position in a route's walk (SPEC 3.4). A route owns its graph and its walk runs from node to node, so a route ends at its own node and nothing else holds a handle part-way along one of its arcs. The same walk in a network's highlight is valid, which is why this rule is separate from every walk rule and needs its own case. A route is its own highlight, so the route is dropped where a highlight would be. The first route is the same route ending at its node, and survives.

diagnostics.message_advisory: a route's walk runs node to node, and this `to` is a position — the route is dropped
